verdict.rationale: Warp's privacy docs and open-source announcement say its client source code is published at github.com/warpdotdev/warp under AGPL v3. The GitHub repo itself shows an active open contribution process (labeled issues, @oss-maintainers), which corroborates the claim; the single 'closed-source' community remark is general sentiment rather than a concrete counter-example. Missing for 10: evidence that the server-side/cloud agent (Oz) components are open, and any detail on how much of the product the open client covers.
